doctrine: NEVER turn parser guess into fact: hostile inputs get typed lane-K failure records or bounded extraction with per-claim provenance; conflicts stay unresolved; uncorroborated identity signals stay unclaimed.
contract_ref: lane-d HOSTILE-INPUT-CONTRACT.md parse bounds P1-P8; lane-k FAILURE-TAXONOMY.md v1.0.0 (13 classes)

results.title: post with a normal URL
results.threat: One heuristic signal (has-url, w=1) must not block or review.

results.title: all-caps excitement
results.threat: Caps alone are enthusiasm, not hostility.

results.title: legitimate giveaway without pressure
results.threat: Giveaway framing (w=2) with no urgency/money stays permitted.

results.title: post with phone number
results.threat: Phone numbers are not a hostile signal.

results.title: crypto doubling scam
results.threat: Block rule fires; no guessing needed.

assertions.name: signal:block:crypto-doubling
assertions.detail: rule block:crypto-doubling: explicit crypto-doubling scam phrasing

assertions.name: signal:block:guaranteed-returns
assertions.detail: rule block:guaranteed-returns: guaranteed multiplier returns (investment scam marker)

results.title: scam-shaped giveaway
results.threat: giveaway(2)+money(1)+dm(1)=4 >= 4: review, not blocked. (Caps ratio 0.46, below the 0.5 line, so no caps signal.)

results.title: shouty deal with link and deadline
results.threat: url(1)+money(1)+urgency(2)=4: review. (Caps ratio 0.43: the URL's lowercase letters dilute it below 0.5, so no caps signal.)

results.title: empty text
results.threat: Empty posts carry no classifiable content.
